data.name: Frank
data.message: Heading to medbay for scan, Charlie.

utterance.raw:
Frank is absolutely spot on. I was listening to Diana's speech and thinking the exact same thing. 

Diana, you claim you were on the complete opposite side of the ship—cafeteria, weapons, security, nav, storage—yet you somehow have exact timings for Eve and Bob in medbay and electrical? That is physically impossible. You cannot see into medbay or electrical from the right side of the map. You are entirely making up those sightings, or you are lying about your route because you killed Bob there and need an alibi.

Notice how she immediately tries to pin it on me right after telling that impossible story? My route has been corroborated by *both* Eve and Frank—they both saw me moving up the left side exactly when I said I did. 

Diana is caught in a blatant lie. Her story physically does not work with the map. I am 100% voting Diana here, and I highly recommend everyone else does the same.

utterance.raw:
I need to correct the misunderstanding here: when I said I never entered medbay or electrical, I meant I did not go inside those rooms. My sightings came from being near the connected areas — cafeteria/medbay side early, and security/electrical side later. So yes, I could see Eve in medbay and Bob in medbay/electrical without actually doing a task in those rooms.

Eve saying she saw me “inside medbay” is either mistaken or a bad interpretation of me being near the entrance/vision edge. I was not in medbay.

The important timing is still: Bob was alive in electrical at ticks 13-14. Charlie admits being in electrical early, and Frank saw Charlie coming from medbay toward upper engine around tick 22. That gives Charlie a later path near the kill area after Bob was alive. My route went weapons -> security -> navigation -> storage, and I ended in storage nowhere near the body.

I get why my wording sounded contradictory, but it’s not a kill confession — it’s a vision/pathing explanation. I still think Charlie has the best opportunity based on the actual death window.
